## Wang Liang Master (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
Wang liang monk 6  
LE Medium outsider (evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +17  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 21, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +1 deflection, +1 Dodge, +1 monk, +3 natural, +4 Wis)  
**hp** 124 (4d10+18 plus 6d8+12 plus 6); fast healing 2  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +13, **Will** +13; +2 vs. enchantment  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, maneuver training, still mind; **DR** 5/silver; **Immune** disease, poison; **Resist** fire 5  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** bite +12 (1d6+4 plus poison), 2 claws +12 (1d4+4 plus poison) or unarmed strike +12/+7 (1d8+4) or +1 kama +14/+9 (1d6+5) or unarmed flurry of blows +12/+12/+7 (1d8+2) or kama flurry of blows +1 kama +14/+14/+9 (1d6+5)  
**Special Attacks** flurry of blows, poison, Stunning Fist (fatigued, DC 17)  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 4th):  

At will—detect good  
3/day—curse water (DC 11), darkness  


**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 19, **Con** 15, **Int** 10, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +18; **CMD** 31  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Disarm, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning Fist, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Weapon Focus (kama), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness, Great Fortitude; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +13 (+19 jumping), Bluff +8, Climb +9, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (planes) +5, Perception +17, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +13, Survival +10  
**Languages** Common, Infernal  
**SQ** fast movement, high jump, ki pool (7 points, magic), purity of body, slow fall (30 ft.)  
**Combat Gear** potion of haste; **Other Gear** +1 kama, ring of protection +1  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Bite, Claw–injury; *save* Fort DC 17; *frequency* 1/round for 2 rounds; *effect* 1d4 Str; *cure* 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.
